install_mock_triton: install a mock triton module stub so modules importing triton load without error on unsupported platforms
create_mock_module: create a mock module that acts as a pass-through decorator for triton.jit and other triton APIs
build_meta_path_finder: build a meta-path finder that intercepts all import triton.* statements and registers mock modules
test_stub_base_class: test the stub base class that allows safe subclassing by external code referencing triton classes
review_install_function: review the install function that registers mock triton package in sys.modules when real triton is unavailable
